package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

// Optional provenance tooling. Ordinary checked-in fixture replay needs only
// Elixir/Rust. Raw upstream distinct results remain separate from the complete
// result over actual engine-selected parents and their original event times.
func TestPulseEventTimes(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT required")
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-event-times"
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	write := func(name string, v any) {
		b, e := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), append(b, '\n'), 0644); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	ns := []int64{0, 1, -1, 999, -999, 1000, -1000, 1001, -1001, 999999, -999999, 1000000, -1000000, 1000001, -1000001, 999999999, -999999999, 1000000000, -1000000000, 60000000000, 3600000000000, 3661002003004, math.MaxInt64, math.MinInt64}
	random := uint64(0x6f4d0a731b2c95e8)
	for i := 0; i < 256; i++ {
		random ^= random << 13
		random ^= random >> 7
		random ^= random << 17
		ns = append(ns, int64(random))
	}
	attr := func(k, v string) *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: v}}}
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	rows := []*Trace{}
	for i, n := range ns {
		// All source times stay inside Pulse's 0..int64max event-time domain.
		// Differences include negative offsets, explicit protobuf default zero,
		// zero offset, all subsecond units and both signed-domain boundaries.
		start, event := uint64(1), uint64(0)
		if n >= 0 {
			event = uint64(n) + 1
		} else {
			start = uint64(-n)
		}
		// Exact signed extrema cannot both be differences of a positive span
		// start and nonnegative int64 event time. Stored rows cover the
		// nearest representable endpoints without wrapping source times.
		if n == math.MaxInt64 {
			event = math.MaxInt64
		}
		if n == math.MinInt64 {
			start = math.MaxInt64
		}
		finish := start + 20
		if finish > math.MaxInt64 {
			finish = math.MaxInt64
		}
		tid, sid := make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 8)
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(tid[8:], uint64(i+1))
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(sid, uint64(i+1))
		svc := "worker"
		if i%2 == 1 {
			svc = "frontend"
		}
		events := []*tv.Span_Event{{TimeUnixNano: event, Name: "offset"}, {TimeUnixNano: start, Name: "zero"}, {TimeUnixNano: start + 1, Name: "one"}}
		if start == math.MaxInt64 {
			events = events[:2]
		}
		if i%13 == 0 && i > 1 {
			events = nil
		}
		sp := &tv.Span{TraceId: tid, SpanId: sid, Name: fmt.Sprintf("span-%d", i), StartTimeUnixNano: start, EndTimeUnixNano: finish, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("shared", "span")}, Events: events}
		resource := &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource: &rv.Resource{Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("service.name", svc)}}, ScopeSpans: []*tv.ScopeSpans{{Scope: &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: "scope"}, Spans: []*tv.Span{sp}}}}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, resource)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, tid, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{resource}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, e := proto.Marshal(all)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	tag, e := traceql.ParseIdentifier("event:timeSinceStart")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	consumed := 0
	for _, q := range []string{`{}`, `{resource.service.name="worker"}`, `{resource.service.name="frontend"}`, `{resource.service.name="absent"}`, `{resource.service.name=~"work.*"}`, `{span.shared=~"spa.*"}`, `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.shared="span"}`} {
		rawSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
			return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
		})
		collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { rawSet[v] = true; return false })
		if e = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, collect, fetch); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		found, e := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
			return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
		}))
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		ids := map[string]bool{}
		for _, tr := range found.Traces {
			if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
				t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
			}
			for _, sp := range tr.SpanSet.Spans {
				ids[tr.TraceID+"/"+sp.SpanID] = true
			}
		}
		completeSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
			for _, ss := range r.ScopeSpans {
				for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
					if !ids[util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)+"/"+util.SpanIDToHexString(sp.SpanId)] {
						continue
					}
					for _, ev := range sp.Events {
						completeSet[tempopb.TagValue{Type: "int", Value: strconv.FormatInt(int64(ev.TimeUnixNano-sp.StartTimeUnixNano), 10)}] = true
					}
				}
			}
		}
		sorted := func(set map[tempopb.TagValue]bool) []*tempopb.TagValue {
			v := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for p := range set {
				p := p
				v = append(v, &p)
			}
			sort.Slice(v, func(i, j int) bool { return v[i].Value < v[j].Value })
			return v
		}
		complete := sorted(completeSet)
		cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"target": "event:timeSinceStart", "query": q, "raw": map[string]any{"tagValues": sorted(rawSet)}, "complete": map[string]any{"tagValues": complete}})
		for _, version := range []int{1, 2} {
			b, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/value-%02d-v%d.protobuf", dir, len(cases)-1, version))
			if os.IsNotExist(e) && os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_CONSUMER") != "1" {
				continue
			}
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if version == 2 {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: complete}) {
					t.Fatal("v2 mismatch")
				}
			} else {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				want := []string{}
				for _, v := range complete {
					want = append(want, v.Value)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{TagValues: want}) {
					t.Fatal("v1 mismatch")
				}
			}
			consumed++
		}
	}
	write("oracle.json", cases)
	t.Logf("%d actual public consumer messages", consumed)
	_ = root
}
